title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Bonus on Pocketwire Advance Room
content:
The plan of the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account adds to the room for a new advance on the linked Pocketwire Advance line. When the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Summit, 2 times the tier's plan limit bonus is added to the room; when it is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Prime, the tier's plan limit bonus is added to the room; any other plan adds nothing to the room. The plan is the one the personal account's record shows.

## Amounts added, by tier of the line (USD)

| Tier of the line | Plan limit bonus | Pocketwire Summit adds | Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Prime adds | Pocketwire Lite, Core or Plus adds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 25.00 | 50.00 | 25.00 | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 25.00 | 50.00 | 25.00 | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 50.00 | 100.00 | 50.00 | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 50.00 | 100.00 | 50.00 | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 100.00 | 200.00 | 100.00 | Nothing |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A line on Pocketwire Advance Plus whose customer is on Pocketwire Summit: 100.00 is added to the room.
- The same line with the customer on Pocketwire Prime: 50.00 is added.
- A line on Pocketwire Advance Starter: the plan limit bonus of the tier is 0.00, so every plan adds 0.00.
